name: G. G. Cooper
bio: G. G. Cooper was day telegraph operator at Medora until April 1885, when he moved to a corresponding position at Billings, where the paper said he earned a reputation as one of the best operators on the road. By September 1886 he was working for Western Union in St. Paul.

moments.label: Left Medora for an operator's post at Billings
Working for Western Union in St. Paul

mentions: …nd W. H. Minty of Minneapolis now takes his place. A. D. Green has been transferred to New Rockford and G. G. Cooper takes his place. Mr. Elverson will remain with us for some time.
G. G. Cooper, formerly day operator here, went to Billings Monday night to accept a corresponding position there. We are pleased at his promotion but sorry to lose him as he made man…

We neglected to mention last week that G. G. Cooper, now telegraph operator at Billings, visited Medora on a short leave of absence. He has established the reputation of being one of the best operators on the road.
G. G. Cooper, a former operator here, is now pounding the key for the Western Union in St. Paul.
